hardware.tested_state: host-tested review activity helper linked into ESP-IDF runtime

procedure: Added a host-buildable T-Display S3 review activity helper covering active state, timeout math, activity refresh, clear behavior, and unsigned tick wraparound.
Ran nSealr/esp32 make ci with 34 Python tests, host-core tests, and firmware validation.
Built the T-Display S3 firmware with ESP-IDF v5.5.4 from /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh.
Confirmed the ESP-IDF build reported app version 258dade.
Ran the default USB serial smoke suite with 33 verified exchanges.
expected_result: The timeout state helper remains host-testable, links into the ESP-IDF runtime, and preserves the disabled signing protocol contract.
observed_result: The 258dade firmware built successfully, flashed on /dev/cu.usbmodem1101, and passed 33 USB serial smoke exchanges: 6 response frames and 27 expected rejection frames. sign_event remained signing_disabled.
limitations: This is build/flash/protocol smoke evidence for the refactored timeout-state implementation, not a five-minute manual visual timeout observation.
The helper tracks review activity state only; it does not authorize or execute signing.
The protocol response for sign_event remains signing_disabled.
No persistent key custody, secure boot, flash encryption, debug-lock, enclosure, or production approval policy was validated.
